concept: VPC endpoints: S3 access only from a VPC via gateway endpoint + aws:SourceVpce
tests: How to restrict bucket access to one specific VPC, with no path over the internet.
expected: Gateway VPC endpoint for S3 + bucket policy with Deny if aws:SourceVpce ≠ the endpoint ID. Triggers: "accessible only from a specific VPC", "never over the public internet".
why_not: A public bucket contradicts the requirement; IGW/NAT and Transfer Acceleration go over the public path.
